en: Black‑and‑white view of a cloister-like courtyard of an ivy-covered college building. The image is framed by stone columns with ornate capitals in the foreground, opening onto a formal garden with paths, trimmed bushes, and a central statue on a tall pedestal. Large multi-pane windows line the surrounding walls. At the bottom of the image, in a decorative script, appears the caption "Canisius-College."
